text: Confirmed and filed #6586: VFP9 SP2 docs explicitly permit RENAME *.prg TO *.bak; native VFP COM renamed two binary matches (including NUL bytes) to .bak and preserved contents. Copperfin did not expand wildcard matches even when resolver expressions returned the wildcard strings, isolating this from #6585 bare-operand parsing; current handler passes patterns to std::filesystem::rename. Issue open, owner-authored, labeled bug/runtime/agent-approved. No production changes.
